description: Defines an interface for AMQP 0.9.1 protocol configuration settings, including a method to get publisher acknowledgement TTL and an enum for default config values.

classes.name: Amqp091Config
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for the AMQP 0.9.1 protocol.

classes.name: ConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and default values for `Amqp091Config`.

methods.name: getPublisherPendingAckTTL
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait for broker acknowledgment for a published AMQP message, used for translating into a Ditto Acknowledgement.
